title: Why Your Drains Are Gurgling: The Hidden Venting Issue
description: When water drains from a fixture, it displaces air within the drainage piping. Without proper atmospheric venting, flowing water creates a negative pressure vacuum inside the system. This siphon effect pulls air through nearby fixture traps, causing distinct gurgling sounds and pulling out the protective water seal. Over time, depleted traps allow hazardous sewer gases to enter living spaces. Resolving this issue requires inspecting atmospheric vent stacks for blockages such as leaves or ice, verifying proper vent sizing, and ensuring any installed air admittance valves function correctly according to local plumbing standards.
